scenarios.title: Dropping files from Finder onto a pane types their shell-escaped paths at the cursor without Enter
Text copied in another macOS app pastes into a pane with ⌘V, bracketed only when the program asked for it
⌘-clicking a URL in a pane opens it in the system browser, and Reveal in Finder on a file link shows it in Finder
In the desktop window, ⌘R renames the tab and never reloads the webview; under Terminal first ⌘T reaches the terminal and opens no tab
In the desktop window, visible panes render with WebGL (at most 12 contexts) and the memory probe at the typical-day workload stays within budget
